Field: Shop title (the short line under your shop name)
Where on Etsy: Shop Manager > pencil icon next to your shop name under Sales Channels > Add a shop title or Edit
What to write: What you sell + what makes it different. Use the words buyers type.
Limit or rule: Up to 55 characters. It also shows in Google results. No "best", no CAPITALS, no emoji.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Handmade stoneware mugs and vases in soft colours

Field: Line 1: news or what buyers must know now
Where on Etsy: Shop Manager > pencil icon next to your shop name > Announcement > Add a shop announcement or Edit
What to write: The one thing that matters this week: a delivery cut-off, a holiday break, a new collection. Add the date if it ends.
Limit or rule: One sentence. Most important line. Remove it when the date has passed.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Holiday orders: order by 12 December for delivery before 24 December (UK addresses).

What to write: How long it takes to make and send an order.
Limit or rule: Must match the processing time in your listings and shipping profiles.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Every piece is made to order and ships in 5 to 7 working days.

What to write: What you make and one true detail about how.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): We make stoneware mugs and vases by hand, in batches of 20 to 30.

What to write: Point to one shop section and say how to ask a question.
Limit or rule: Name a real section in your shop. Questions go through Etsy Messages.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Looking for a gift? See the Gift Sets section. Questions? Send us a message on Etsy.

What to write: Lines 1 to 4 pasted one under the other.
Limit or rule: Keep it short: Etsy's own help says "short and sweet". 2 to 4 short lines is a good target.

Where on Etsy: Shop Manager > Settings > Your shop > Shop home editor > About section > About your shop
What to write: Who you are, what you make, how many people make it.
Limit or rule: 1 to 2 sentences. Use [Name] if you do not want to show a full name.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Fernmoor is a two-person pottery studio. [Name] throws every mug and vase on the wheel, and [Name] glazes, packs and answers your messages.

What to write: The real reason. One clear idea a buyer can picture.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): We started Fernmoor because we wanted mugs that feel good to hold every morning: a wide handle, a thick rim and a size that fits a full coffee.

What to write: Materials, steps and tools. Say who helps, including any production partner.
Limit or rule: 2 to 4 sentences. Honest about who makes what.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Each piece is made from stoneware clay, glazed in our own colours and fired twice in our kiln. Because every piece is made by hand, the speckles and glaze lines are a little different on each one.

What to write: Processing time, packing, care, custom orders.
Limit or rule: 2 to 3 sentences. Must match your listings and policies.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Orders are made to order and ship in 5 to 7 working days, wrapped in recycled paper and a gift box. All mugs are dishwasher and microwave safe.

What to write: One clear action: a section to browse or a message for custom work.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Want a custom set or a different colour? Send us a message on Etsy and tell us what you have in mind.

Limit or rule: Etsy allows 5,000 characters or less. 120 to 300 words is plenty for most shops.

Where on Etsy: Shop home editor > About section > Featured photos
What to write: Real photos: hands at work, workspace, materials, packing an order, the finished range. One short caption each.
Limit or rule: .jpg, .png or .gif, up to 2 MB each. Etsy crops them to 760 x 468 px, so keep the subject in the middle.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): 1 Throwing a mug on the wheel / 2 Glaze test tiles / 3 Mugs drying on the shelf / 4 Packing an order in a gift box / 5 The full colour range

Where on Etsy: Shop home editor > About section > Featured video
What to write: A short real clip of you making or packing. No music you do not have the rights to.
Limit or rule: MP4, MOV, AVI, MPEG or M4V, up to 300 MB.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): 15-second clip of a mug being glazed and lifted out of the kiln

Where on Etsy: Shop home editor > About section > Shop team
What to write: Name, role, a 1-line bio and a photo for each real person.
Limit or rule: Only real people who work on the shop. Owners also show on listing pages.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): [Name], potter and owner: makes every piece on the wheel. / [Name], glazing and orders.

Where on Etsy: Shop home editor > Shop basics > Logo
What to write: A clear logo or a simple shop name mark, easy to read when small.
Limit or rule: .jpg, .png or .gif, smaller than 10 MB, at least 500 x 500 px.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up shop): Fernmoor name in charcoal on a cream square

Where on Etsy: Shop home editor > About section > Links
What to write: Your own website or social profile only if you keep it up to date.
Limit or rule: Do not ask buyers to buy outside Etsy. Etsy's fee rules do not allow it.

What to write: Read the title, announcement and About text again. Update dates, times and sections.
Limit or rule: Every month, and before every holiday or break.
